name: arr
description: Agent skills for running a Radarr/Sonarr media stack: API connection doctrine and the container-path trap, the instance map that stops profile-id guessing, quality profiles and the cutoff settings that cause endless upgrade storms, monitoring drift and guarded delete-then-regrab, the search-to-import chain, and the grab decisions that make your player transcode. Distilled from years of running a real stack with coding agents.
